LanguageData.Grechka_CryoSlow.label: cryo slow
LanguageData.Grechka_CryoSlow.description: Frost restricts movement. Further hits refresh the duration without increasing the effect.
LanguageData.Grechka_CombatChipT4_Hediff.label: berserker chip T4
LanguageData.Grechka_CombatChipT4_Hediff.description: Suppresses pain and normal mood-related mental breaks. Move speed +2, melee dodge chance +10 percentage points, melee damage ×1.5. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_CombatChipT5_Hediff.label: berserker chip T5
LanguageData.Grechka_CombatChipT5_Hediff.description: Suppresses pain and normal mood-related mental breaks. Move speed +4, melee dodge chance +20 percentage points, melee damage ×2. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_StabilityChipT4_Hediff.label: iron mind chip T4
LanguageData.Grechka_StabilityChipT4_Hediff.descripti: Prevents normal mood-related mental breaks. Does not prevent scripted or forced mental states. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_StabilityChipT5_Hediff.label: iron mind chip T5
LanguageData.Grechka_StabilityChipT5_Hediff.descripti: Prevents normal mood-related mental breaks. Does not prevent scripted or forced mental states. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_CraftChipT4_Hediff.label: artisan chip T4
LanguageData.Grechka_CraftChipT4_Hediff.description: Multiplies the wearer's global work speed by 1.5. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_CraftChipT5_Hediff.label: artisan chip T5
LanguageData.Grechka_CraftChipT5_Hediff.description: Multiplies the wearer's global work speed by 2. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_MovementChipT4_Hediff.label: pathfinder chip T4
LanguageData.Grechka_MovementChipT4_Hediff.descriptio: Increases move speed by 1 and reduces rest loss by 25%. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_MovementChipT5_Hediff.label: pathfinder chip T5
LanguageData.Grechka_MovementChipT5_Hediff.descriptio: Increases move speed by 2 and reduces rest loss by 50%. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_TonicChipT4_Hediff.label: vigor chip T4
LanguageData.Grechka_TonicChipT4_Hediff.description: Reduces hunger rate and rest loss by 50%. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_TonicChipT5_Hediff.label: vigor chip T5
LanguageData.Grechka_TonicChipT5_Hediff.description: Reduces hunger rate and rest loss by 75%. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
LanguageData.Grechka_BrainChipT5_Hediff.label: grechka mind chip T5
LanguageData.Grechka_BrainChipT5_Hediff.description: Increases consciousness by 100 percentage points and grants +16 mood while the chip is installed. Different chip families are compatible. Installing another tier from the same family returns the previous chip as an item.
